caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spoon placed horizontally on a light, off-white background. The spoon has a reflective, silver-gray surface, with subtle shading to indicate its metallic material and contours. The left side shows the rounded bowl of the spoon, which appears smooth and slightly concave with a gradient of light and dark areas to represent reflections and curvature. The handle of the spoon extends to the right, tapering in the middle and widening toward the end, which is squared with rounded corners. On the broad end of the handle, the initials "R.S.G." are inscribed in a decorative script. The edges of the drawing are bordered by a faint, uneven margin in a yellowish hue, possibly indicating age or slight discoloration of the paper. There are no other objects or color variations besides shades of gray and off-white.
title: Silver Tablespoon
